name: io.github.OpsMaxx/opsmaxx
description: SSH, files, containers and databases via the OpsMaxx desktop app - scoped per capability, audited.

environmentVariables.name: OPSMAXX_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token from AI & MCP -> AI Agents -> New AI agent session in the OpsMaxx app. Scoped to one workspace and one access group.

environmentVariables.name: OPSMAXX_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port the OpsMaxx MCP bridge listens on, shown under AI & MCP -> Security. Defaults to the session cached by the opsmaxx CLI.
